label: Trainer
note: Current Rennordnung licenses and regulates trainers; qualification details remain German.

label: Besitzertrainer
note: Current Rennordnung treats Besitzertrainer as a distinct licensed owner-trainer category.

label: Berufsrennreiter
note: Current Rennordnung uses Berufsrennreiter for the licensed professional race-rider category.

label: Amateurrennreiter
note: Current Rennordnung uses Amateurrennreiter for the licensed amateur rider category.

label: Besitzer
note: Current Rennordnung uses Besitzer for the racehorse owner in ownership and training provisions.

label: Starter
note: Richtlinie R4 assigns the Starter responsibility for conducting and organizing the start.

label: Zielrichter
note: The Rennordnung assigns the Zielrichter determination of finishing order and finish margins.

label: Ausgleicher
note: The Rennordnung and Richtlinie R1 use Ausgleicher for the official setting handicap assessments/weights.

label: Rennbahn
note: The Rennordnung uses Rennbahn for the racecourse and prescribes racecourse facilities and condition.

label: Tierarzt
note: The Rennordnung assigns veterinary checks and raceday duties to the Tierarzt.

label: Hufschmied
note: The Rennordnung requires Hufschmied presence within raceday/start operations.

label: Startmaschine
note: Richtlinie R4 uses Startmaschine for the starting-gate equipment checked and positioned for the race start.
